svg.aria-label: A blade's four control points in the vertical plane of up and back. The chord runs from the root, P0, to the tip, P3, leaning back from upright by tilt times 90 degrees; arch is perpendicular to it, away from the ground. P1 and P2 sit a third and two thirds of the way along the chord, pushed out along arch by bend times height over 2, and the curve bows toward them.
